axes.concept: A metal event hoop becomes a spatial access orbit. People occupy stations; a stable inflated aperture holds the current task.
axes.layout: 230px elliptical navigation at left, offset 44px from one asymmetric 82px-radius working aperture. At phone width the ellipse flattens horizontally above the content.
axes.navigation: Three labelled stations follow an ellipse rather than a straight sidebar or bottom dock. Account menu and native preview selectors remain explicit; invitation and reset require existing links.
axes.typography: Locally embedded Rounded Mplus 1c ExtraBold as Air Display at 38–58px, paired with embedded Adwaita Sans as Studio Sans at 14–16px. Rounded heavy titles echo inflated latex.
axes.density: One generous working aperture, 42px desktop and 22px phone internal padding; people are ruled rows with 56px oval identifiers, not dashboard cards. Permission groups use a selectable two-column matrix.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button/Input/Checkbox/Skeleton, Animate UI-backed Dialog/AlertDialog and Motion. Custom elliptical station navigation, inline hoop mark, oval person identifiers and a single-use-link receipt.
axes.colour: Proposal: blue-air #deedf0 with white surfaces and raspberry foil #8b2146; night petroleum #0c2831/#183d49 with rose #f5a5ba. Project semantic role names and written status meanings are retained; no shared purple accent.
axes.motion: Elastic spatial grammar: spring-registering hoop, perspective pod arrival, inflated title settle, rotated arrow settle, staggered person registration, floating foil bead, compressed feedback and tactile controls. Expressive default; all travel/infinite effects collapse for reduced motion and still=1; hidden tabs pause ambient CSS.
